_README: Detection lives here, not in code, because this is the fragile part: it
depends on Whatnot's wording and markup, which they change without
telling anyone. When detection breaks, run `python watch.py probe` on an
open stream, look at the text it dumps, and fix a regex here. No code
Everything is a case-insensitive regex matched against the tab's visible
text. A capture group, where present, is the value extracted.

live._note: giveaway_present is the only REQUIRED one. It is the string the old radar already matched successfully, so it is known real. The rest are best guesses until probed against a live stream — see SPEC open question 3.
live._note_prize: Unconfirmed. If probe shows the prize elsewhere, fix this.
live._note_flags: Unconfirmed. If these never match, buyers-only giveaways will alert like any other — annoying, not harmful.
live.followers_only: followers only|follow to enter|following to enter
live._note_challenge: Matched the same way the radar does it. A challenged tab is skipped, never reloaded.
live.challenge: just a moment|attention required|checking your browser|verify you are human|enable javascript and cookies to continue

purchases._note: SPEC open question 2. Rows are read with a CSS selector because innerText alone gives no row boundaries. The default is a guess; run `python watch.py probe` with the purchases tab open and send the output if it finds nothing.
purchases._note_row_min: Rows shorter than this are chrome/navigation, not purchases.
